entries.effect: the time of the engine's render loop: nil while the engine is stopped or paused; while started, an AVAudioTime at 48 kHz whose sample time is the frames the loop has rendered since the engine last started, and whose host time is the loop's last tick. The loop advances the clock and renders no audio yet, because the engine holds no sound events

SDK 16.4 and 26.2 PHASE.framework PHASEObject.h, byte-identical on the members; PHASE arrived in iOS 15 and the port's releases are 6.1.3 and 4.3, so there is no PHASE.framework on either. The transform is a simd_float4x4 and both transforms start at the identity written out as a literal - the SDK's matrix_identity_float4x4 is a function the 6.1.3 gate names as a weak import the release does not export - and the world transform is the object's own composed with every ancestor's; the root is a PHASEObject, the property's declared type - the host's is a PHASERootObject, a framework-internal subclass with no row in the corpus, and the declared type is what an application sees
